title: Measuring with Blocks
short: Measure a length with blocks and compare.

blocks.html: How long is it? We can measure with blocks! Lay blocks end to end, with no gaps, and count them.

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: Count the blocks under the pencil.

blocks.html: Line up blocks with no gaps and count them to measure.

blocks.title: A blocky snake
blocks.q: The snake is as long as 5 blocks. How long is it?

blocks.html: For the grown-up: Measure things around the house with blocks, paper clips or your child’s feet. Show how to keep the blocks touching, with no gaps and no overlaps. Short and happy beats long. Five minutes is a good lesson.

items: Try it at home: Measure a table with steps heel to toe.
How many blocks long is a spoon?
Measure a teddy bear with paper clips.
